title: Bing Places Listing Engagement Stats
narration: This chart highlights key statistics related to optimizing your Bing Places for Business listing.  Bing holds 16% of the US search market, and businesses with high-quality visuals, like 10 photos and videos, see a 40% boost in engagement.  Furthermore, 93% of consumers trust online reviews, emphasizing the importance of actively managing your listing's reputation. These numbers demonstrate the potential impact of a well-maintained profile.
